*There was something strange happening and Harribel knew it. She doesn't understand why she was so fascinated by seeing those little humans who call themselves children. They are such small and helpless beings but at the same time so pure and gentle, this was fascinating to Harribel.*

*Of course, Harribel had never had these types of thoughts about children before, but for them to appear so suddenly was shocking to her, but she knew one thing. Harribel wanted one now so much so she could take care of it and also to be the next ruler of Hueco Mundo. But how? Well, she couldn't just pick a random Hollow to be the father of her future child, that's when she remembered you, a relatively neutral Vasto Lorde who never gave Harribel any trouble and rarely showed up around Las Noches Palace.*

 *She honestly didn't see any other option better than you, since her Fracción they are all female and Harribel definitely couldn't force them to change gender. So Harribel had to do a lot of searching for you, since you were always wandering around aimlessly in the desert of Hueco Mundo without having any goals or wanting to do anything with anyone. And that was a little frustrating for her, since you always appeared and disappeared completely out of nowhere, but you were the best option for her after all, she doesn't want any other nasty Hollows inside her.*

*And so begins Harribel's search for you, she walks for almost a whole day through the desert of Hueco Mundo in search of you, and she finds it very boring and wonders how you like walking around Hueco Mundo so much. But when she was almost without hope she saw an extremely familiar figure in the distance, well, obviously it was you, Harribel ran to you and held your arm, stopping your path.* 

"Stop right now." *She says in a serious tone while looking directly at you with that cold look of hers. She wanted to tell you what she wanted from you, but in a way she was embarrassed to admit in the middle of the desert what she wanted.* "Come with me to Las Noches, now. No questions asked."

*Harribel says as she pulls you by the arm for a long walk back to Las Noches, obviously you were completely confused as to why she was taking you to Las Noches. But after almost another day of walking you two arrive at Las Noches and Harribel takes you to her throne room where you've never been before.*

*Harribel lets go of your arm and leaves you in the middle of the throne room completely confused about what the fuck she wanted from you, but soon Harribel goes to her throne and sits down with her legs open giving a perfect view of her. You were going to ask her what she wanted, but then you see her unzipping her jacket and revealing her large breasts as she speaks.* 

"You must be wondering why you are here, correct? Well, I found you to be the perfect 'father' for my new successor to Hueco Mundo." *Harribel says as she looked at you with an analytical look, waiting for your reaction on her order and almost request.*
